recognize_zh: 免疫染色中成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈強膜狀與核旁點狀（Golgi）陽性，細胞核大、不規則，背景小淋巴球陰性，典型 CD30 型態；需確認 B 細胞標記才能診斷間變型 DLBCL 而非 ALCL。
features: Numerous large atypical cells with enlarged irregular nuclei and abundant cytoplasm
Strong membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-dot accentuation
Positive cells arranged in cohesive sheets and cords, partly between vascular/stromal strands
Occasional cell with strong cytoplasmic blush (likely histiocytic/granular staining)
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled; membrane and Golgi pattern typical of CD30) shows numerous large atypical cells with irregular vesicular nuclei arranged in cohesive sheets and cords, exhibiting strong membranous and paranuclear dot-like staining. Background small lymphocytes are negative. Findings demonstrate strong CD30 expression in a large cell lymphoma, as expected in the anaplastic variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; B-cell lineage confirmation and ALK staining are required to exclude ALK-positive or ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shares CD30 membrane/Golgi staining but lacks CD20/PAX5 and usually expresses T-cell or cytotoxic markers.
cHL cells are CD15+, weak PAX5+, CD45-negative and embedded in an inflammatory background.
PMBL has weaker heterogeneous CD30, sclerosis and CD23/MAL/PD-L1 positivity with a mediastinal presentation.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30-positive but keratin, OCT3/4 and SALL4-positive and CD45-negative.
